name: psmisc
description: The Psmisc package contains programs for displaying information about running processes.

installed_descriptions.name: fuser
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the Process IDs (PIDs) of processes that use the given files or file systems

installed_descriptions.name: killall
installed_descriptions.description: Kills processes by name; it sends a signal to all processes running any of the given commands

installed_descriptions.name: peekfd
installed_descriptions.description: Peek at file descriptors of a running process, given its PID

installed_descriptions.name: pslog
installed_descriptions.description: Reports current logs path of a process

installed_descriptions.name: pstree
installed_descriptions.description: Displays running processes as a tree

installed_descriptions.name: pstree.x11
installed_descriptions.description: Same as pstree, except that it waits for confirmation before exiting
